description:
Replace your fund's live lineup in one call.

    roster: [{"bot_id": "dir_long_btc", "weight_pct": 60}, {"bot_id": "...", "weight_pct": 25}]
    Weights are % of the fund; anything under 100 stays in cash. Bots that
    stay keep their positions, removed bots are closed at market, new bots open
    on their next signal (Always Long/Short bots open right away). The change
    and your rationale go into the fund's public history.
name: set_fund_lineup
